description: Two complete items of text span the input, since their captured parts have different tag sets. The one tagged P elides T at 1, and the one tagged Q elides nothing. The root combines both, so the input is resolved, through Q (engine §4, §6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision %elidable T %rule text $x(a) %rule a A [T]

| A
